settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure grouping rules, naming rules and appearance
settings.preview_max_mb_tooltip: Max preview size for a single image (MB). Images larger than this will not generate a preview. Set to 0 to disable preview. Currently only works for common bitmap formats, RAW preview is not supported yet.
settings.sub_second_digits_tooltip: Number of sub-second digits shown in capture time (0-9). Set to 0 to hide sub-seconds.
settings.aeb_max_span_tooltip: Max allowed time difference between first and last photo in an AEB group (seconds). Sequences exceeding this span will not be recognized as AEB groups. Recommended: 0.3-1.0 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.aeb_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval between consecutive photos in an AEB group (seconds). Helps filter duplicate entries. Recommended: 0.01-0.1 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.aeb_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval between consecutive photos in an AEB group (seconds). Recommended: 0.1-0.5 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.aeb_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required for an AEB group. Typical AEB brackets are 3, 5, or 7 shots.
settings.aeb_auto_bracket_tooltip: When enabled, only photos with EXIF ExposureMode set to 'Auto bracket' (value 2) will be recognized as AEB groups. Manual brackets will be ignored.
settings.focus_enabled_tooltip: Disable to stop recognizing focus bracket groups and avoid confusion with burst sequences. Only enable when focus bracketing is needed.
settings.focus_max_span_tooltip: Max allowed time difference between first and last photo in a focus bracket group (seconds). Recommended: 0.5-2.0 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.focus_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval between consecutive photos in a focus bracket group (seconds). Recommended: 0.01-0.05 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.focus_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval between consecutive photos in a focus bracket group (seconds). Recommended: 0.2-1.0 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.focus_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required for a focus bracket group. Recommended: 3-7 photos.
settings.burst_min_consecutive_tooltip: Minimum time interval between consecutive photos in a burst group (seconds). Recommended: 0.01-0.05 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.burst_max_consecutive_tooltip: Maximum time interval between consecutive photos in a burst group (seconds). Recommended: 0.3-1.0 sec. Set to -1 to disable.
settings.burst_min_count_tooltip: Minimum number of photos required for a burst group. Typically at least 3.
settings.focus_bracket_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for focus bracket groups. Organized photos will be placed in a directory starting with this prefix.
settings.aeb_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for AEB groups.
settings.burst_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for burst groups.
settings.single_prefix_tooltip: Output directory prefix for single photos. Leave empty to use original filename without prefix.
settings.plugin_hint: Place plugin ZIP files in the plugins/ folder under the application directory
